embeds.title: 📌  Guild Board: download, install and every update
embeds.description:
**[⬇️  Get the latest version](https://github.com/KrisHendo09/guild-board/releases/latest)**
This link always points to the newest release, so it never goes stale.
​

fields.name: 1️⃣  Download
fields.value: Open the link and click **GuildBoard.zip** under Assets

fields.name: 2️⃣  Unzip
fields.value:
Drop the **GuildBoard** folder into
`World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns`
Replace the old one if it asks

fields.name: 3️⃣  Restart WoW
fields.value: Fully close and reopen. Type `/gb` in game to check it loaded

fields.name: 🔔  Out of date?
fields.value: The addon tells you in game when a guildie has a newer version. Every new version gets posted right here in this thread

fields.name: 🛠️  Something broken?
fields.value: Type `/gb bug` in game and it gets to me

fields.name: ⚙️  CurseForge
fields.value: Auto updates are on the way once CurseForge approves the project

footer: Updates land as replies below  ·  Push To Prod  ·  For the Horde
